items.summary: Q: Do you have an idea of what you want to work on in the winter? "In some ways, yes. I've kinda understood largely, for a while, what I need to try and fix but doing it has been very challenging this year. Clearly our car isn't as competitive this year as it was last year and also just some of the characteristics of it just not quite as nice. But yeah! I'm working on it. Trying to find new ways to drive fast, that's been the name of the game this year so yep. I'm still pushing for that and ultimately what I want to try and do for the rest of the year is try and learn as much as I can for next year. Thats kind of the biggest thing. We'll keep pushing with that and see how we go."
items.summary_zh: 问：你知道冬歇期想改进什么吗？“某种程度上，是的。有一段时间了，我大致明白自己需要努力修正什么，但今年做起来非常困难。显然我们的车今年不如去年有竞争力，而且它的一些特性也没那么顺手。不过是的！我在努力。试着找到新的开快车的方式，这就是今年的主题，是的。我还在为此努力，最终我今年剩余时间想做的就是尽可能多地为明年学习。这大概是最重要的事。我们会继续推进，看看进展如何。”
